name: Wikidata Main Structured Data
citation: Wikidata main structured data: 2026-06-08 full-dump checksum metadata and independently retrieved 2026-06-12 Wikidata Query Service extracts.
notes: The full-dump checksum sidecars and the local language extracts have distinct lineage.
